instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Apex Data Analytics is a mid-sized IT firm specializing in providing tailored data visualization and consulting services to various B2B clients. The company focuses primarily on improving operational efficiency for existing enterprise clients through bespoke software integrations.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have successfully implemented several incremental updates to our proprietary reporting dashboards, focusing on internal process improvements. We also recently piloted a small-scale expansion into a niche AI-driven predictive maintenance tool for manufacturing partners.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is strategic diversification by entering adjacent data analytics markets and developing new product lines outside our core consulting services. We aim to establish presence in the FinTech integration space over the next three years.
answers.teamSize: The team consists of 8 full-time employees, highly skilled in data science and cloud infrastructure management.

opportunities.title: Service Line Expansion (Niche Integration)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging our existing talent and formal process, we can incrementally expand into a specific vertical like FinTech integration. This is lower risk as it builds on current technical expertise.

first_actions: Identify three high-potential FinTech partners for pilot projects.
Develop a standardized 'FinTech Readiness' service package scope.
resources_needed: SaaS subscription for specialized financial data APIs (approx. $1,500/year)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two paying pilot contracts within 6 months.
milestones: Q3: Finalize service blueprint and pricing model.
Q4: Launch first FinTech integration project.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Micro-SaaS Tool Development
opportunities.rationale: To achieve true diversification, we can build a small, focused software tool solving a specific pain point in the market. While high risk, keeping the scope highly narrow allows for controlled testing within our conservative budget.

first_actions: Conduct market validation interviews with 100 potential users.
resources_needed: Contract a freelance AI/ML developer for MVP build ($5,000 - $8,000)
Internal time allocation: 10 hours per week from one senior engineer.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 50 active beta users within the first quarter.
milestones: Month 4: Public launch and initial revenue generation.

next_steps.action: Form a small task force to define the top three diversification targets (e.g., FinTech, Healthtech).
Audit current internal talent capabilities against identified future needs and prioritize upskilling for the next 12 months.
Develop a detailed cost-benefit analysis comparing incremental expansion costs vs. radical tool development risks.

key_weaknesses: Dependency on key senior technical talent for critical projects.
Limited institutional knowledge outside of current core service offerings.
Slow internal bureaucracy hindering rapid prototyping and testing cycles.
